name: Prismwake
detail: Rainbow/prism set, luminous-looking through opaque colors not actual glow. Matte ivory and charcoal frame enclosing faceted spectral panes, ruby through orange/yellow/emerald/cyan/violet in an intentional ordered progression. Head overhead asymmetrical pentagonal prism helmet with little stepped crystal ridge. Body rounded ivory shoulder frames holding rainbow crystal wedges, graphite harness and diamond clasp. Pickaxe a single bent prismatic quartz blade in a charcoal frame, ivory grip with spectral insets. Glider shallow faceted rainbow glass fan with ivory ribs, dark side handles. Sophisticated restrained facets, no cloudy gradients, no unrelated rainbow icons.

name: Cinder Apiary

Body chunky charcoal shoulders framed in brass with large amber hexagonal cells and ivory padded collar. Pickaxe a brass honey-scraper crescent with angular comb cutouts and charcoal wrapped handle, one amber wax insert. Glider shallow canopy built from broad amber hexagonal cell panels with charcoal rim and dark brass side handles. No bees, particles or hanging honey drips.

Pickaxe a powerful red C-jaw magnet-shaped hooked tool with exposed steel ends and dark ribbed grip, no floating scraps. Glider broad shallow segmented ferrite-red canopy with graphite bands and steel side handle mounts. Heavy bold industrial geometry, no robot face or generic sci-fi glow.
